BASE_SHA = "59e3b166c2d010d5e62be52c2be76d98a94af0e0"
SEED = 786
ROOT = Path("/home/kamimura/projects/tennis-lab/.claude/worktrees/issue-786-base-golden")
OUT = Path(
    "/home/kamimura/projects/tennis-lab/.claude/worktrees/"
    "issue-786-normalization-v2/.codex/tasks/issue-786/logs/"
    "legacy-base-goldens/representative"
)
SCALE = np.asarray(COURT_COORD_SCALE_XYZ, dtype=np.float32)


def _run(*args: str) -> str:
    return subprocess.run(
        args,
        cwd=ROOT,
        check=True,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    ).stdout.strip()


def _sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _tree_evidence(root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    aggregate = hashlib.sha256()
    files: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for path in sorted(candidate for candidate in root.rglob("*") if candidate.is_file()):
        relative = path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
        digest = _sha256(path)
        size = path.stat().st_size
        aggregate.update(relative.encode("utf-8"))
        aggregate.update(b"\0")
        aggregate.update(bytes.fromhex(digest))
        aggregate.update(b"\n")
        files[relative] = {"sha256": digest, "byte_count": size}
    return {
        "sha256": aggregate.hexdigest(),
        "algorithm": "sha256(relative_posix_path + NUL + binary_sha256(file) + LF)",
        "file_count": len(files),
        "byte_count": sum(int(value["byte_count"]) for value in files.values()),
        "files": files,
    }


def _array_evidence(arrays: dict[str, np.ndarray]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    result: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name, array in sorted(arrays.items()):
        contiguous = np.ascontiguousarray(array)
        result[name] = {
            "shape": list(contiguous.shape),
            "dtype": str(contiguous.dtype),
            "sha256": hashlib.sha256(contiguous.tobytes()).hexdigest(),
            "finite": bool(np.isfinite(contiguous).all())
            if np.issubdtype(contiguous.dtype, np.number)
            else True,
        }
    return result


def _jsonable(value: Any) -> Any:
    if isinstance(value, torch.Tensor):
        value = value.detach().cpu().item()
    if isinstance(value, np.generic):
        value = value.item()
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {str(key): _jsonable(item) for key, item in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return [_jsonable(item) for item in value]
    return value


def _write_json(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
    path.write_text(
        json.dumps(_jsonable(value), indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


def _save_checkpoint(path: Path, module: torch.nn.Module, config: DictConfig) -> None:
    checkpoint = {
        "epoch": 0,
        "global_step": 0,
        "pytorch-lightning_version": pl.__version__,
        "state_dict": module.state_dict(),
        "loops": {},
        "callbacks": {},
        "optimizer_states": [],
        "lr_schedulers": [],
        "hparams_name": "kwargs",
        "hyper_parameters": {"config": config},
    }
    torch.save(checkpoint, path)


def _checkpoint_state_matches(path: Path, module: torch.nn.Module) -> bool:
    checkpoint = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
    saved = checkpoint["state_dict"]
    loaded = module.state_dict()
    return set(saved) == set(loaded) and all(
        torch.equal(saved[key], loaded[key]) for key in saved
    )


def _compose_blcs_config() -> tuple[DictConfig, list[str]]:
    overrides = [
        "model=multiview_axial_small",
        "model.hidden_dim=16",
        "model.num_layers=1",
        "model.num_heads=4",
        "model.ffn_dim=32",
        "model.rope_dim=4",
        "model.camera_layers_per_stage=[1]",
        "model.time_layers_per_stage=[1]",
        "model.time_global_stage_mask=[false]",
        "model.max_seq_len=2",
        "model.max_num_cameras=1",
        "model.num_court_tokens=14",
        "model.dropout=0.0",
        "data.seq_len_range=[2,2]",
        "data.num_views_range=[1,1]",
        "data.camera_mode=first",
        "data.num_court_kp=14",
        "data.batch_size=1",
        "data.num_workers=0",
        "training.compile.enabled=false",
    ]
    with initialize_config_dir(
        version_base="1.3", config_dir=str(ROOT / "src/tasks/blcs/configs")
    ):
        config = compose(config_name="train", overrides=overrides)
    return config, overrides


def _compose_plcs_config() -> tuple[DictConfig, list[str]]:
    overrides = [
        "model=multiview",
        "loss=no_canonical",
        "model.hidden_dim=16",
        "model.num_layers=1",
        "model.num_heads=4",
        "model.ffn_dim=32",
        "model.rope_dim=4",
        "model.max_seq_len=2",
        "model.max_views=1",
        "model.dropout=0.0",
        "data.seq_len_range=[2,2]",
        "data.num_views_range=[1,1]",
        "data.min_cameras=1",
        "data.camera_mode=first",
        "data.num_court_kp=14",
        "data.batch_size=1",
        "data.num_workers=0",
        "training.compile.enabled=false",
    ]
    with initialize_config_dir(
        version_base="1.3", config_dir=str(ROOT / "src/tasks/plcs/configs")
    ):
        config = compose(config_name="train", overrides=overrides)
    return config, overrides


def _camera_parameters() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "R": np.eye(3, dtype=np.float32).tolist(),
        "C": [0.0, 0.0, -10.0],
        "f": 800.0,
        "cx": 640.0,
        "cy": 360.0,
        "w": 1280,
        "h": 720,
    }


def _write_blcs_fixture(root: Path) -> np.ndarray:
    scene = root / "scenes/scene_representative_blcs"
    scene.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (root / "test.txt").write_text("scene_representative_blcs\n", encoding="utf-8")
    target_norm = np.asarray(
        [[0.20, -0.30, 0.40], [-0.40, 0.50, 0.60]], dtype=np.float32
    )
    target_m = target_norm * SCALE
    velocity_mps = np.asarray(
        [[1.0, 2.0, 3.0], [-1.5, 0.75, -2.25]], dtype=np.float32
    )
    ball_uv = np.asarray([[0.48, 0.52], [0.53, 0.47]], dtype=np.float32)
    court_uv = np.linspace(0.1, 0.9, 28, dtype=np.float32).reshape(14, 2)
    arrays = {
        "ball_pos_norm": target_norm,
        "ball_pos_world": target_m,
        "ball_vel_world": velocity_mps,
        "cam_0_ball_uv": ball_uv,
        "cam_0_ball_vis": np.ones(2, dtype=np.bool_),
        "cam_0_court_kp_uv": court_uv,
        "cam_0_court_kp_vis": np.ones(14, dtype=np.bool_),
        "cam_0_ball_visibility_ratio": np.asarray(1.0, dtype=np.float32),
        "cam_0_court_visibility_count": np.asarray(14.0, dtype=np.float32),
    }
    for name, array in arrays.items():
        np.save(scene / f"{name}.npy", array)
    _write_json(
        scene / "meta.json",
        {
            "scene_id": "scene_representative_blcs",
            "num_frames": 2,
            "num_cameras": 1,
            "num_cameras_sampled": 1,
            "fps_out": 30,
        },
    )
    _write_json(
        scene / "scalars.json",
        {"num_cameras": 1, "cam_0_params": _camera_parameters()},
    )
    return target_norm


def _write_plcs_fixture(root: Path) -> np.ndarray:
    scene = root / "scenes/scene_representative_plcs"
    scene.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (root / "test.txt").write_text("scene_representative_plcs\n", encoding="utf-8")
    target_norm = np.asarray(
        [[0.25, -0.50, 0.75], [-0.20, 0.40, 0.60]], dtype=np.float32
    )
    rotation = np.asarray([[1.0, 0.0], [0.0, 1.0]], dtype=np.float32)
    human_uv = np.linspace(0.15, 0.85, 68, dtype=np.float32).reshape(2, 17, 2)
    court_frame = np.linspace(0.1, 0.9, 28, dtype=np.float32).reshape(14, 2)
    court_uv = np.repeat(court_frame[None, ...], 2, axis=0)
    human_world = np.zeros((2, 17, 3), dtype=np.float32)
    human_world[..., 0] = target_norm[:, None, 0] * SCALE[0]
    human_world[..., 1] = target_norm[:, None, 1] * SCALE[1]
    human_world[..., 2] = target_norm[:, None, 2] * SCALE[2]
    human_world += np.linspace(-0.2, 0.2, 51, dtype=np.float32).reshape(1, 17, 3)
    canonical_pose = np.zeros((2, 73, 3), dtype=np.float32)
    arrays = {
        "position": target_norm,
        "rotation": rotation,
        "human_kp_3d": human_world,
        "canonical_pose_3d": canonical_pose,
        "cam_0_human_kp_uv": human_uv,
        "cam_0_human_kp_vis": np.ones((2, 17), dtype=np.bool_),
        "cam_0_court_kp_uv": court_uv,
        "cam_0_court_kp_vis": np.ones((2, 14), dtype=np.bool_),
        "cam_0_human_visibility_ratio": np.asarray(1.0, dtype=np.float32),
        "cam_0_court_visibility_count": np.asarray(14.0, dtype=np.float32),
    }
    for name, array in arrays.items():
        np.save(scene / f"{name}.npy", array)
    _write_json(
        scene / "meta.json",
        {
            "scene_id": "scene_representative_plcs",
            "num_frames": 2,
            "num_cameras": 1,
            "num_cameras_sampled": 1,
            "fps": 30.0,
            "initial_yaw": 0.0,
        },
    )
    _write_json(
        scene / "scalars.json",
        {"num_cameras": 1, "cam_0_params": _camera_parameters()},
    )
    return target_norm


def _resolver() -> PathResolver:
    return PathResolver(
        RuntimePathRoots(
            project_root=ROOT.resolve(),
            data_root=(ROOT / "data").resolve(),
            checkpoint_root=OUT.resolve(),
            artifact_root=OUT.resolve(),
            output_root=OUT.resolve(),
            cache_root=(OUT / "cache").resolve(),
            external_asset_root=(ROOT / "data").resolve(),
        )
    )


def _tensor_arrays(batch: dict[str, Any], names: list[str]) -> dict[str, np.ndarray]:
    return {
        f"input_{name}": batch[name].detach().cpu().numpy()
        for name in names
        if isinstance(batch.get(name), torch.Tensor)
    }


def _npz(path: Path, arrays: dict[str, np.ndarray]) -> None:
    np.savez_compressed(path, **arrays)


def main() -> None:
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    observed_sha = _run("git", "rev-parse", "HEAD")
    if observed_sha != BASE_SHA:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Base HEAD mismatch: {observed_sha}")
    status_before = _run("git", "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all")
    if status_before:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Base worktree is not clean before generation: {status_before}")

    random.seed(SEED)
    np.random.seed(SEED)
    torch.manual_seed(SEED)
    torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)
    torch.set_num_threads(1)

    blcs_config, blcs_overrides = _compose_blcs_config()
    plcs_config, plcs_overrides = _compose_plcs_config()
    if "court_coordinate_normalization" in blcs_config:
        raise AssertionError("Frozen-base BLCS config unexpectedly contains normalization metadata.")
    if "court_coordinate_normalization" in plcs_config:
        raise AssertionError("Frozen-base PLCS config unexpectedly contains normalization metadata.")

    blcs_fixture = OUT / "datasets/blcs_legacy_v1"
    plcs_fixture = OUT / "datasets/plcs_legacy_v1"
    _write_blcs_fixture(blcs_fixture)
    _write_plcs_fixture(plcs_fixture)

    blcs_dataset = BallTrajectoryDataset(
        scene_dir=blcs_fixture,
        split_file=blcs_fixture / "test.txt",
        config=blcs_config,
        augment=False,
    )
    blcs_dataset.rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)
    blcs_sample = blcs_dataset[0]
    blcs_batch = dict(collate_multiview_trajectories([blcs_sample]))

    plcs_dataset = SceneDataset(
        scene_dir=plcs_fixture,
        split_file=plcs_fixture / "test.txt",
        config=plcs_config,
        augment=False,
    )
    plcs_dataset.rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)
    plcs_sample = plcs_dataset[0]
    plcs_batch = dict(collate_plcs_batch([plcs_sample]))

    for target in (blcs_batch["position_3d"], plcs_batch["position"]):
        target_m = target * torch.tensor(SCALE, dtype=target.dtype)
        if not bool((target_m.abs().sum(dim=(0, 1)) > 0).all()):
            raise AssertionError("Representative target must be nonzero on XYZ.")

    torch.manual_seed(SEED)
    blcs_binding = compose_blcs_trajectory_model_io(blcs_config)
    blcs_module = BLCSLightningModule(blcs_config, model_io=blcs_binding).cpu().eval()
    blcs_checkpoint = OUT / "blcs_representative_legacy_v1.ckpt.bin"
    _save_checkpoint(blcs_checkpoint, blcs_module, blcs_config)

    torch.manual_seed(SEED)
    plcs_module = PLCSLightningModule(plcs_config).cpu().eval()
    plcs_checkpoint = OUT / "plcs_representative_legacy_v1.ckpt.bin"
    _save_checkpoint(plcs_checkpoint, plcs_module, plcs_config)

    resolver = _resolver()
    blcs_predictor = BLCSPredictor.load_from_checkpoint(
        blcs_checkpoint, resolver=resolver, device="cpu"
    )
    plcs_predictor = PLCSPredictor.load_from_checkpoint(
        plcs_checkpoint, resolver=resolver, device="cpu"
    )

    blcs_reload_binding = compose_blcs_trajectory_model_io(
        load_checkpoint_config(blcs_checkpoint)
    )
    blcs_reloaded = BLCSLightningModule.load_from_checkpoint(
        blcs_checkpoint,
        map_location="cpu",
        model_io=blcs_reload_binding,
        strict=True,
        weights_only=False,
    ).cpu().eval()
    plcs_reloaded = PLCSLightningModule.load_from_checkpoint(
        plcs_checkpoint,
        map_location="cpu",
        strict=True,
        weights_only=False,
    ).cpu().eval()

    blcs_strict_match = _checkpoint_state_matches(blcs_checkpoint, blcs_reloaded)
    plcs_strict_match = _checkpoint_state_matches(plcs_checkpoint, plcs_reloaded)
    if not blcs_strict_match or not plcs_strict_match:
        raise AssertionError("Strictly reloaded Lightning state differs from checkpoint.")

    blcs_reloaded.test_metrics.reset()
    with torch.no_grad():
        blcs_result = blcs_reloaded._compute_supervised_result(blcs_batch, "test")
        blcs_norm = blcs_predictor.predict_batch(blcs_batch, denormalize=False)
        blcs_meters = blcs_predictor.predict_batch(blcs_batch, denormalize=True)
    blcs_aggregate_metrics = blcs_reloaded.test_metrics.compute()
    torch.testing.assert_close(
        blcs_result["outputs"].position.cpu(), blcs_norm.position, rtol=0.0, atol=0.0
    )
    if blcs_norm.velocity is None or blcs_meters.velocity is None:
        raise AssertionError("Representative BLCS model must predict velocity.")
    torch.testing.assert_close(
        blcs_meters.position,
        blcs_norm.position * torch.tensor(SCALE),
        rtol=0.0,
        atol=0.0,
    )
    torch.testing.assert_close(
        blcs_meters.velocity,
        blcs_norm.velocity * torch.tensor(SCALE),
        rtol=0.0,
        atol=0.0,
    )

    plcs_reloaded.test_metrics.reset()
    with torch.no_grad():
        plcs_result = plcs_reloaded._compute_supervised_result(plcs_batch, "test")
        plcs_norm = plcs_predictor.predict(
            plcs_batch["human_kp"],
            plcs_batch["court_kp"],
            plcs_batch["human_vis"],
            plcs_batch["padding_mask"],
            plcs_batch["court_vis"],
            denormalize=False,
        )
        plcs_meters = plcs_predictor.predict(
            plcs_batch["human_kp"],
            plcs_batch["court_kp"],
            plcs_batch["human_vis"],
            plcs_batch["padding_mask"],
            plcs_batch["court_vis"],
            denormalize=True,
        )
        plcs_physical = plcs_predictor.predict_multiview_observations(
            human_kp=plcs_batch["human_kp"].numpy(),
            court_kp=plcs_batch["court_kp"].numpy(),
            human_vis=plcs_batch["human_vis"].numpy().astype(np.bool_),
            padding_mask=plcs_batch["padding_mask"].numpy(),
            court_vis=plcs_batch["court_vis"].numpy().astype(np.bool_),
        )
    plcs_aggregate_metrics = plcs_reloaded.test_metrics.compute()
    torch.testing.assert_close(
        plcs_result["outputs"].position.cpu(), plcs_norm["position"], rtol=0.0, atol=0.0
    )
    torch.testing.assert_close(
        plcs_meters["position_meters"],
        plcs_norm["position"] * torch.tensor(SCALE),
        rtol=0.0,
        atol=0.0,
    )
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(
        plcs_physical.position_meters, plcs_meters["position_meters"].numpy()
    )

    blcs_losses = {
        name: float(value.detach().cpu().item())
        for name, value in blcs_result["losses"].items()
    }
    blcs_batch_metrics = {
        name: float(value) for name, value in blcs_result["metrics"].items()
    }
    plcs_batch_metrics = {
        name: float(value) for name, value in plcs_result["metrics"].items()
    }
    plcs_loss_values = {
        name.removeprefix("loss_"): value
        for name, value in plcs_batch_metrics.items()
        if name.startswith("loss_")
    }

    blcs_arrays = {
        **_tensor_arrays(
            blcs_batch,
            ["ball_uv", "ball_vis", "court_kp", "court_vis", "padding_mask"],
        ),
        "target_position_normalized": blcs_batch["position_3d"].numpy(),
        "target_position_meters": blcs_batch["position_3d"].numpy() * SCALE,
        "target_velocity_world_mps": blcs_batch["velocity_3d"].numpy(),
        "prediction_position_normalized": blcs_norm.position.numpy(),
        "prediction_position_meters": blcs_meters.position.numpy(),
        "prediction_velocity_normalized": blcs_norm.velocity.numpy(),
        "prediction_velocity_meters_per_second": blcs_meters.velocity.numpy(),
        **{
            f"loss_{name}": np.asarray(value, dtype=np.float32)
            for name, value in blcs_losses.items()
        },
        **{
            f"metric_batch_{name}": np.asarray(value, dtype=np.float64)
            for name, value in blcs_batch_metrics.items()
        },
        **{
            f"metric_aggregate_{name}": np.asarray(value, dtype=np.float64)
            for name, value in blcs_aggregate_metrics.items()
        },
    }
    plcs_arrays = {
        **_tensor_arrays(
            plcs_batch,
            ["human_kp", "human_vis", "court_kp", "court_vis", "padding_mask"],
        ),
        "target_position_normalized": plcs_batch["position"].numpy(),
        "target_position_meters": plcs_batch["position"].numpy() * SCALE,
        "target_rotation_cos_sin": plcs_batch["rotation"].numpy(),
        "target_human_kp_3d_meters": plcs_batch["human_kp_3d"].numpy(),
        "prediction_position_normalized": plcs_norm["position"].numpy(),
        "prediction_position_meters": plcs_meters["position_meters"].numpy(),
        "prediction_rotation_cos_sin": plcs_norm["rotation"].numpy(),
        "prediction_yaw_radians": plcs_meters["yaw_radians"].numpy(),
        **{
            f"loss_{name}": np.asarray(value, dtype=np.float32)
            for name, value in plcs_loss_values.items()
        },
        **{
            f"metric_batch_{name}": np.asarray(value, dtype=np.float64)
            for name, value in plcs_batch_metrics.items()
        },
        **{
            f"metric_aggregate_{name}": np.asarray(value, dtype=np.float64)
            for name, value in plcs_aggregate_metrics.items()
        },
    }
    blcs_golden = OUT / "blcs_representative_legacy_v1_golden.npz"
    plcs_golden = OUT / "plcs_representative_legacy_v1_golden.npz"
    _npz(blcs_golden, blcs_arrays)
    _npz(plcs_golden, plcs_arrays)

    status_after = _run("git", "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all")
    if status_after:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Base worktree changed during generation: {status_after}")

    checkpoint_payloads = {
        "blcs": torch.load(blcs_checkpoint, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False),
        "plcs": torch.load(plcs_checkpoint, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False),
    }
    manifest = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "issue": 786,
        "evidence_kind": "base-compatible representative legacy-v1 parity",
        "base": {
            "worktree": str(ROOT),
            "sha": observed_sha,
            "tracked_clean_before": status_before == "",
            "tracked_clean_after": status_after == "",
        },
        "runtime": {
            "python_seed": SEED,
            "numpy_seed": SEED,
            "torch_seed": SEED,
            "torch_deterministic_algorithms": True,
            "torch_num_threads": 1,
            "device": "cpu",
            "dtype": "float32",
            "court_coordinate_scale_xyz_meters": SCALE.tolist(),
        },
        "commands": {
            "generation": f"cd {ROOT} && .venv/bin/python {OUT / 'generate_representative.py'}",
            "verification": (
                f"cd {ROOT} && .venv/bin/python -m json.tool "
                f"{OUT / 'manifest.json'} >/dev/null && git status --porcelain=v1 "
                "--untracked-files=all"
            ),
        },
        "tasks": {
            "blcs": {
                "model_class": type(blcs_predictor.model).__module__
                + "."
                + type(blcs_predictor.model).__qualname__,
                "io_adapter_class": type(blcs_predictor.io_adapter).__module__
                + "."
